news.t: Federal Reserve Board announces 2027 pricing for its payment services, effective Jan 1, 2027. The Board expects the Reserve Banks to recover 101.5 percent of actual and imputed expenses in 2027 and estimates an average price increase of 1.4 percent for established services; check services are being streamlined, with higher check processing fees.
Federal Reserve announces revised tentative 2027 FOMC meeting schedule

commentary.note: The Generic edition's own text for this close, carried on the tape.
read: The FOMC held the federal funds target range at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 in a 10–2 vote; Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack dissented, preferring a quarter-point increase. The September projections put the median federal funds rate at 4.1% for the end of 2026 (central tendency 4.1–4.4%). October headline CPI rose 0.4% and October core CPI 0.3% on the month, and BLS did not publish October 12-month changes for all-items or core CPI; September headline PCE ran 3.6% and September core PCE 3.1% from a year earlier; October nonfarm payrolls rose 165,000 and the October unemployment rate was 4.1%. The minutes of the Oct 27–28 meeting are due Wednesday, Nov 18, the week’s main release.

Treasury’s Nov 13 close put the 2-year at 4.88%, the 10-year at 5.15% and the 30-year at 5.47%, leaving 2s10s at +27 bp, 3 bp steeper than the day before. The 2-year is 37 bp higher since Nov 6 and the 10-year 29 bp higher since Nov 6, so 2s10s is 8 bp flatter since Nov 6. The 2-year sits 100 bp above the 3.88% effective funds rate printed Nov 12. Overnight money sits inside the range: EFFR printed 3.88% on Nov 12 and SOFR 3.90%, with IORB at 3.90%.

For a deposit-funded balance sheet the move since Nov 6 cuts both ways. Higher yields lower fixed-rate AFS market values and deepen unrealized losses, and they lift new-money yields by a similar amount; both show up in the next AOCI and EVE run. On the funding side, the 12-month CD at 4.65%, first in Bankrate’s ranked list (BTG Pactual Bank), sits above the 3.88% effective funds rate. Renewal betas on maturing CDs are being tested against a retail bid above overnight wholesale money.

panels.p: The target range is 3.75–4.00%, held Oct 28, with IORB at 3.90% and the ON RRP rate at 3.75%. EFFR printed 3.88% on Nov 12 and SOFR 3.90% the same day; the 30-day SOFR average was 3.92% on Nov 13. Along the curve, the 3-month bill closed Nov 13 at 4.32%, the 5-year at 4.98% and the 20-year at 5.52%, above the 30-year at 5.47%; 3M10Y is +83 bp and 5s30s +49 bp.

Bankrate retrieved Nov 16, 2026: 12-month CD 4.65%, first in Bankrate’s ranked list (BTG Pactual Bank); high-yield savings 4.35%, first in Bankrate’s ranked list (CIT Bank); money market 4.05%, first in Bankrate’s ranked list (Zynlo Bank). These are advertised consumer yields, not comparable one-for-one with a wholesale rate or a cost of funds. The Fed’s primary credit (discount window) rate is 4.00%, effective Sep 17.
